summary: GreenPower Motor Company Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the completion of the third tranche of a preferred share financing. On June 30, 2026, it issued 1,500 Series A Convertible Preferred Shares for gross proceeds of $1,425,000 under a November 14, 2025 agreement with an institutional investor. The agreement was also amended to increase the aggregate stated value by $2 million. Each preferred share is convertible into common shares at a conversion price based on 105% of stated value divided by 125% of the prior day's closing price. A 5% cash placement fee is payable to Digital Offering LLC. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
